verdict.rationale: The evidence describes codec bitrates and automatic subscription to lower-bitrate streams. These are media-configuration behaviors, not per-session quality metrics exposed for debugging. Nothing in the pack documents a dashboard or API that reports packet loss, jitter, or bitrate per session, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, and bitrate are available through a dashboard or API for debugging calls
